title: The Last Supper

location.name: Milan
location.institution: Refectory of the Convent of Santa Maria delle Grazie

object.medium: tempera on gesso, pitch and mastic
object.description: Painted on the north wall of the refectory of Santa Maria delle Grazie in Milan, the mural shows the moment Jesus tells the apostles that one of them will betray him. Leonardo abandoned true fresco for an experimental tempera-on-dry-wall technique, which let him work slowly but began to deteriorate within decades.
facts: The apostles are arranged in four groups of three, reacting in waves to Jesus's announcement.
The perspective lines converge on Jesus's right temple.
A door was cut through the bottom of the mural in 1652, removing Jesus's feet.
The refectory survived an Allied bomb in 1943 that destroyed the roof and one wall; the mural had been sandbagged.

tour: Leonardo's Last Supper at its real size, nearly nine metres across: the moment after 'one of you will betray me'.
